polishes.name: Rituoil
polishes.description: MOURNING FIG The opening greets you with lush, velvety fig, dark and secretive. Cassis lingers beneath like a berry kiss, rich and impossible to forget. At its heart, water lily drifts across still waters, soft and spectral. The base curls in musk’s embrace, warmed by the tender caress of Madagascar vanilla. A scent that lingers like a whisper, sweet, sorrowful, and just a little haunting. Top: fig, cassis Heart: water lily Base: musk, Madagascar vanilla For those who like: Green, skin musk, clean and woodsy fragrance. LAIT TO REST The opening greets you with creamy milk, soft and comforting. Honey and caramel melt together at the heart, warm and indulgent. White musk lingers like a gentle presence, sweet and serene. A scent to lull the senses and charm the night. Notes-Top: creamy milk Heart: warm caramel, honey Base: white musk For those who like gourmand, sweet, lactonic and comforting fragrance FAMILIAR The opening greets you with aromatic cardamom and soft lavender, warm and quietly comforting. At its heart, creamy milk melts into the gentle sweetness of vanilla, smooth and soothing as a familiar presence curled beside you. Tonka bean deepens the sweetness with its warm, velvety embrace. Silky woods linger beneath, softening the fragrance into something warm, cozy and comforting. A scent that feels like coming home to something familiar and always waiting for you. Notes- Top: cardamom, lavender Heart: milk, creamy vanilla Base: tonka bean, silky woods For those who like: Warm, milky, soft woods and cozy fragrances. THE VEIL The opening blooms with delicate jasmine and lilac soft and ethereal like flowers drifting through a forgotten garden. At its heart, lily of the valley, white musk linger like a quiet presence just beyond reach, clean and luminous. The base settles into moss and creamy sandalwood, earthy and smooth, grounding the fragrance while keeping an air of mystery. A scent that feels suspended between worlds. Floral, hushed, and hauntingly beautiful. Top: jasmine, lilac, lily of the valleyHeart: white muskBase: moss, creamy sandalwood For those who like: Soft florals, white musk, creamy woods, and earthy fragrance. SUGAR BAT Top: raspberry, caramelHeart: marshmallow, cyclamen, evening primroseBase: cedarwood For those who like: Sweet gourmands, soft florals, airy sweetness, and warm woods. LOVE YOU, LOVE YOU Top: strawberry bon bon, apple blossomHeart: dark cassis, parchmentBase: oakmoss, cedarwood For those who like: Fruity florals, dark berries, earthy woods, and sweet atmospheric fragrance. 1 oz fl glass bottle with glass dropper. Rituoil ingredients: Organic golden jojoba oil, organic sweet almond oil, organic avocado oil and fragrance oil
